Why families fall for Maltipoos

A cross between a Maltese and a Poodle, the Maltipoo is gentle, clever and eager to please. The soft, low-shedding coat suits many allergy sufferers, and the small size fits apartments and houses alike.

They love company, so they do best with people who are home often and happy to cuddle.

About Mia & Larry

A small family breeder with a big love for little dogs.

Mia & Larry began with a simple belief: the first weeks of a puppy’s life shape the dog it becomes. What started as a love for small companion dogs has grown into a modest breeding program, built around a few cherished family dogs rather than volume.

Every litter is born and raised inside our home, never in a kennel or outbuilding. Our puppies grow up with everyday household sounds, gentle handling and daily attention, so they arrive confident, social and ready to settle into a new family.

We keep our numbers small on purpose. It lets us give each puppy a veterinary check, careful records and individual time, and it lets us get to know every family that welcomes one of our puppies home. When a puppy leaves us, we stay available for advice, questions and updates for as long as you need us.

Meet our puppiesRead our FAQ

Why we breed Maltipoos

The Maltese and Poodle combination gives a soft, low-shedding coat and a gentle, intelligent nature. Maltipoos are affectionate, adaptable and eager to please, which makes them a loving companion for first-time owners, seniors and busy families alike.

Why we breed Chihuahuas

Chihuahuas are loyal, spirited and deeply devoted to their person. As the smallest of the companion breeds, they bring a big personality to a compact, easy-to-manage size, and they form some of the strongest bonds of any dog.

Temperament first

We breed for a sound, friendly nature before size or color, because a good companion matters for many years to come.

Health and care

Veterinary checks, up-to-date records and a nutritious start give every puppy the best foundation.

Honest and personal

Clear answers, real photos and direct contact with the people who raised your puppy.

Questions, answered

Do Maltipoos shed?

Very little. Their hair-like coat sheds minimally, though it needs regular brushing to prevent tangles.

Are they good with children and other pets?

Yes. They are gentle and playful, but young children should always be supervised around small dogs.

How big will my Maltipoo get?

Most adults weigh 5 to 12 lbs and stand 8 to 14 inches tall.

How much exercise do they need?

Short daily walks and indoor play are enough for most. They are energetic but not demanding.

Can they stay home alone?

They bond closely with their people and can develop separation anxiety, so build alone-time up gradually.

How often should I groom?

Brush several times a week and plan a trim every 6 to 8 weeks. Start early so grooming feels normal.

Policies

Please read our policies before reserving a puppy. If anything is unclear, message us and we will gladly explain.

Deposit Policy

A non-refundable deposit of $300 is required to reserve a puppy. Once the deposit is received, the puppy will be marked as Reserved and held exclusively for you until pickup or delivery. The remaining balance must be paid before or at the time of pickup or delivery unless otherwise agreed in writing.

Payment Methods

We accept all online payment methods. We confirm payment instructions directly with you in writing, by email at georgelarri01@gmail.com or by phone or WhatsApp at +1 (914) 540-7148. Please pay only to instructions confirmed that way, and keep your receipt. A written receipt is provided for every payment.

Return & Refund Policy

We are committed to the lifelong well-being of every puppy we place. If, at any time, you are unable to keep your puppy, you agree to contact us before transferring ownership, rehoming, surrendering, or placing the puppy in a shelter.

Within 14 days of receiving your puppy, you may return the puppy if a licensed veterinarian documents a serious congenital or hereditary condition that significantly affects the puppy’s quality of life. Upon review of the veterinary documentation, we may offer a replacement puppy or a partial or full refund at our sole discretion.

Deposits are non-refundable because reserving a puppy removes it from availability to other families. However, if we are unable to provide the reserved puppy due to unforeseen circumstances, you may choose either a full refund of your deposit or transfer the deposit to another available puppy.

Returns based on personal circumstances, housing restrictions, allergies, lifestyle changes, financial reasons, or family decisions are not eligible for a refund. However, we will make reasonable efforts to assist with rehoming whenever possible.

Health Guarantee

All puppies are raised in a loving home environment and examined by a licensed veterinarian before joining their new families. Each puppy comes with age-appropriate vaccinations, deworming records, a veterinary health report, and a written health guarantee.

We guarantee that each puppy is in good health at the time of transfer. Buyers are encouraged to have their puppy examined by a licensed veterinarian within 72 hours of arrival. Failure to obtain a veterinary examination within this period may void health-related claims under this guarantee.

Delivery & Pickup

We offer safe nationwide delivery and local pickup options. All delivery arrangements are made with the comfort and safety of the puppy as our highest priority. We provide regular updates, photos, and videos throughout the process and are happy to schedule live video calls so you can meet your puppy before making your final commitment.

Governing Law

These Policies and any agreement arising from the purchase, reservation, delivery, or ownership of a puppy from Mia & Larry shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California.

By placing a deposit, purchasing a puppy, or using our services, you agree that any dispute, claim, or legal proceeding arising out of or relating to these Policies, the sale of a puppy, or any related transaction shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Los Angeles County, California.

Trust Promise

We are happy to provide live video calls, additional photos and videos, health records, and ongoing support to ensure you feel completely confident throughout the adoption process.
